Art direction for the whole series: premium illustrated dark explorer's atlas, hand-engraved fine linework, restrained voxel-inspired architecture, charcoal navy paper #13191e, warm antique brass and muted teal accents, matte painted texture, excellent depth, sophisticated rather than noisy. This chapter is a welcoming island harbor at dusk: a small lantern-lit adventurer's outpost and stone path in the lower-left corner, an enchanting observatory and faint violet constellations in the lower-right corner, a discreet compass engraving high at the top. The middle 75 percent is mostly smooth dark ink and mist; protect ALL regions occupied by the 3 quest nodes and V-shaped paths in the reference. Keep recognizable scenery concentrated in outer 15 percent and corners. Attractive corner illustrations may be luminous but not bright white. No text, no words, no numbers, no logos, no border frame, no UI, no pretend nodes, no painted quest paths. Dark outer edges fade smoothly toward #15181e to blend with the game UI. The result must work beneath bright thin dependency lines and node labels, never compete with them.
